get.summary: Read original receipt and active conversation head under the same scope lock

post.description: RUN-CANCEL@1: stop the currently accessible original message run. Resolve identity through the existing MESSAGE owner, never a supplied run/scope. Creation of an undispatched RUN and cancellation are one transaction. Repeat requests return the same terminal/highwater; already completed/failed/unknown terminals are not overwritten. Only committed cancellation prevents subsequent worker step starts; a lock/commit/owner/response failure is unknown and must reconcile the original run through existing reads. No automatic model/tool retry. In-flight work may settle but late output cannot change the terminal. Closed/foreign/absent/unavailable sources are indistinguishable. No query parameters.

200.description: Committed cancellation or unchanged existing terminal; request_id is tracing, not business idempotency.

default.description: 400 invalid input, 413 body too large, 415 media type, 401/403 initial AUTH denial; 503 unavailable or possibly committed/unknown cancellation. No synthetic terminal or null success.

RequestId.description: Server-generated per HTTP attempt; never an idempotency or authorization token.

receipt.description: Required property: committed receipt or explicit null (not observed); absence is invalid. Generated fallback containers must be checked for actual null, never treated as null by case alone.

original_utf8_base64.description: RFC4648 base64 exact original UTF8 bytes, no text reconstruction; empty draft bytes encode as empty string.
RFC4648 base64 exact original UTF8 bytes, no text reconstruction; empty draft bytes encode as empty string.

MemorySaveCommand.description: Strict exact-key original UTF8 JSON carried as octet-stream (maximum 32768 bytes, host may choose smaller). References are not authorization. Host validates canonical subject/slot/context/source; no owner, approval or policy fields. long_term requires context_id=null; current requires explicit validated nonempty context.

input_sha256.description: SHA256 of persisted original operation ledger bytes, returned by producer save/query decoder; manual nine-key input, never derived source/item Command bytes.

MemoryReceipt.description: Historical original committed save receipt; not current effectiveness or collection approval.

MemoryReceiptQueryResponse.description: Required receipt=null means not observed by original operation_id; never establishes noncommit or permission to resend unknown action.

MemoryListResponse.description: Live item-ID keyset page, not snapshot. next_after is last returned item_id for any nonempty page, null for an empty page. Final nonempty page may require one empty read; no guessed has-more.

MemoryManualSaveCommand.description: First manual save: exactly nine required keys, original immutable UTF8 JSON octet-stream. No source/owner/approval/confirmed fields. Trusted ManualPolicy required; source+item+original receipt created in one transaction. No normalization or invented occurrence time.

TripActionReceipt.description: Historical original canonical Action receipt. Reject committed_version is explicit null; accept version is the then-committed version, never latest Trip inference. No proof of current proposal eligibility or provider fact verification.

TripDocumentItem.description: Producer internal content projection. verified requires nonempty evidence; format validation does not certify factual accuracy. pending remains pending after acceptance.

content_utf8_base64.description: RFC4648 base64 of exact immutable canonical UTF8 content; not a reconstructed presentation string.

TripActionQueryResponse.description: Required receipt null means not observed by original action_id. Does not prove noncommit or permit new-ID retry.

TripListResponse.description: Live Trip-ID keyset page with C byte ordering. next_after is last returned trip_id for any nonempty page and null for an empty page. At most requested limit; no has-more or cross-page snapshot/completeness promise. The complete returned ID is an opaque next boundary, never parsed/incremented.

content_utf8_base64.description: RFC4648 base64 of exact immutable canonical UTF8 content; not a reconstructed presentation string.

TripProposalSnapshot.description: Protected immutable display snapshot. Stored candidate_hash is revalidated by producer against original fields and server scope; never hash a reserialized API body. expires_at is Unix seconds. Stored pending may already be elapsed; this read does not retire, authorize, record review, or confirm acceptance.

TripProposalResponse.description: Missing and wrong-scope candidates both fail generically; no nullable candidate or confirmation evidence is fabricated.

value.description: Explicit IANA timezone, checked by producer. No device/destination/overseas default or cross-field copy.
Exact nonnegative decimal text, retained without division/conversion/implicit zero.
Valid calendar date as original local YYYY-MM-DD string; intentionally not a Date/instant.
Local wall time HH:MM or HH:MM:SS. No UTC/device conversion or DST resolution.

NeedsFixedItem.description: Manual user claim, not supplier verification. Explicit lock is never auto-relaxed. Companion IDs must exist in resultant record.

NeedsFields.description: Only present fields are recorded. Omission differs from explicit missing/unknown/uncertain; never emit absent fields as null or zero. Arrays/maps may be explicitly empty. No long-term Memory or formal Trip writes.

NeedsChanges.description: Nonempty patch; omitted fields retain prior values. Present nested objects/lists replace entire field; explicit empty collection clears. Resultant companion references validated atomically.

NeedsRevision.description: Exact historical original command and full result snapshot, not latest detail. Compare action_id and original_input bytes against preserved original action. No per-field source or historical hash is invented.

id.description: Exact nonblank Unicode ID, maximum1024 UTF8 bytes, no NUL or normalization.

references.description: Empty for general; otherwise exactly one message plus optional one run, kinds unique. No run-only/Trip/Memory/proposal/owner/source diagnostics.

FeedbackAction.description: Exact original UTF8 JSON <=16384 bytes. problem nonblank; expectation may be empty. Each text <=6000 UTF8 bytes and no NUL. Voluntary text is not diagnostics. Do not prefill private transcript or credentials. No automatic redaction claim.

FeedbackSourceObservation.description: Minimal historical read-time observation only. message_input_sha256 hashes original message input, not receipt bytes. No transcript/tool payload or model/rule/usage/duration/failure-stage data is available; absence means unavailable, not zero. Separate source/read/feedback transactions are not atomic across domains; no guarantee of current validity or user-decision-time status.

submitted_at.description: Actual stored database UTC submission time; historical replay/query value.

text.description: Exact persisted display text; empty queued text is allowed. Explicit host UTF8 byte bound, never truncation or generated fallback.

text_state.description: complete only for completed status; every other status is partial, including failed/cancelled/unknown.

RunDisplaySnapshot.description: Read-time original-message-linked persisted display projection. No scope/raw message/events/effects/usage/outbound bytes/model/failure-stage fields. message_sequence differs from event_highwater. Not SSE, a cursor, dispatch or provider-success proof.

RunDisplayResponse.description: BASE envelope must be fully materialized and bounded inside producer protected callback. No nullable or synthetic snapshot on error.

ManualPreviewRequest.description: Read-only preview input. Original bytes from an authenticated Trip read must match server current version/content exactly. Caller retains this entire draft on conflict/unknown. Supports only selected title/text/order; no protected IDs/owner/day/time/lock/proposal/action/confirmation/expiry fields.

ManualPreviewChange.description: Producer Change display metadata, not apply-patch input. before/after are exact canonical JSON value bytes; path is title, items/order, or items/id/<original item ID>.

can_save.description: Always false; no confirmation issuer/feasibility/save authority exists.

ManualPreview.description: Pure local structural diff after same-owner protected reads. No persistence/Proposal/receipt/save/feasibility claim. Missing trusted protected-state context remains UNKNOWN, never unlocked/fully checked.

reserved_units.description: Exact base10 integer-unit count, not currency/float. String avoids SDK integer overflow; no arithmetic or rounding.

oneOf.description: Exact base10 integer-unit count, not currency/float. String avoids SDK integer overflow; no arithmetic or rounding.
Exact base10 integer-unit count, not currency/float. String avoids SDK integer overflow; no arithmetic or rounding.

UsageAttemptStatus.description: Historical original-attempt status in server-authorized period. Counts are exact integer decimal strings; unknown confirmed fields remain null, actual confirmed zero is "0". Opaque unit is not money; reservation/receipt is not current balance/charge or dispatch permission. No whole ledger/input digest/prompts/budget ceiling.

OriginalUsageAssociation.description: Read-time persisted original message-to-usage references only. Not login attempt, ledger row/reservation/status/dispatch/execution/fee evidence or permission. No scope/command/input bytes/digest/reserve/period/unit/text/private metadata. Missing association is unavailable, never synthesized.

OriginalUsageAssociationResponse.description: Complete BASE encoding within original producer read_projected lifetime; exact bytes returned after strict close and final binding. No successful null association.

CurrentAccountCleanupProgress.description: Current ALLOWED account original-operation metadata snapshot only. Complete is limited to original frozen operation, never all-domain/account deletion. Pending/unknown/hooks/retention/offline barriers are not zero or completion. No principal/scope/confirmation/manifest/invocation/receipt/journal/hook/exception details. No recovery/write/hook execution or postlogout capability.

MemoryManagementAction.description: Exact five-key immutable UTF8 JSON; no trimming/normalization/re-encoding; pause/resume only. Existing source approval remains canonical; no text edit, candidate promotion or new approval.

MemoryManagementReceipt.description: Historical original lifecycle receipt. action_id is canonical Receipt.operation_id; hash comes from persisted original action bytes, not request recomputation.

MemoryManagementApplyResponse.description: Receipt after canonical guarded commit and final fences only. Unknown outcome must query original action ID, never automatic resend/new ID.

MemoryManagementReceiptResponse.description: Required null receipt means not observed in this scoped lifecycle ledger; never proves noncommit or authorizes resend.

FeasibilityCurrentEvidence.description: Unmodified original declared JSON value and associated revision/action/hash. Declaration is any JSON value, including null; no external fact or approval asserted.

FeasibilityCurrentCheck.description: Original local deterministic check; PASS does not establish overall or route feasibility.

FeasibilityCurrentSource.description: Private original stored UTF8 history, no normalization or regeneration; hash is original source bytes.

FeasibilityCurrentReport.description: Exact original NEEDS-only projected report. Protected source withholds INVALID input; it is explicit BASE503 FEASIBILITY_INPUT_INVALID, never a fabricated success Report. Overall always UNKNOWN, no write/route/provider authority.

FeasibilityCurrentResponse.description: Full BASE envelope encoded inside original canonical protected NEEDS/AUTH lifetime. Original report bytes embedded unchanged. Candidate factory closed.

action_utf8_base64.description: Exact canonical original action bytes. Persist unchanged; submit only on explicit user confirmation. Unknown outcomes require querying the original action ID, never reissuing replacement bytes.

receipt.description: Required property: committed receipt or explicit null (not observed); absence is invalid. Generated fallback containers must be checked for actual null, never treated as null by case alone.

head.description: Required active conversation head or explicit null. Generated fallback containers must be checked for actual null; invalid/missing data never means an unavailable conversation.

message_id.description: Exact original MESSAGE id, nonblank/no NUL and at most 256 UTF-8 bytes. No caller run id, principal or scope.

RunCancellationRequest.description: RUN-CANCEL@1. Body at most 4096 bytes; duplicate/unknown/missing keys rejected. Stable cancellation identity is trusted principal + cancel + original message_id; JSON whitespace does not create a new action.

RunCancellationResponse.description: Original RUN terminal observed after a durable cancellation transaction. Existing terminals are retained. Prior text/effects remain readable through their original ledgers. Does not claim rollback/refund or physical abortion of an already-started provider request.

CJBearer.description: Only configured CJ JWT verifier and authoritative restricted-business gate; no caller owner or issuer fields.
